description: Before an agent pays an x402 seller: score the seller's Base wallet (or the payTo read from its endpoint's 402 challenge) 0-100 from public USDC transfer history: distinct paying buyers, wash/self-dealing share (self-transfers, round-trips), wallet age, top-payer concentration, 30-day organic volume. Returns verdict, components, reasons and a signed receipt. Deterministic; stateless; never pays anyone. Give address and/or endpoint. Paid: $0.02 USDC on Base, paid in-band via x402 MCP (@x402/mcp; _meta "x402/payment"). Also at POST https://micro-saas-agent.onrender.com/api/seller/reputation.

pass.description: Optional GW8 day pass token (from buy_day_pass / POST /api/pass/day); skips per-call payment
